messages:
Maya: Quick one — we keep seeing duplicate customer asks about per-tenant rate limits and quota UI. Can we land on a clear merging & prioritization rule so support knows what to mark and what to escalate? @Devon @Eli

Devon: Agreed. Current friction: support has no consistent tags and product sees the same request multiple times. My quick proposal: if the ask is functionally identical + same tenant/customer segment, we auto-link and mark as 'stacked'. If >3 unique customers ask within 30 days, escalate to P0/P1 review.

Eli: From AE side — customers want predictable timelines or a clear workaround. For prioritization, please weight: customer count (how many tenants), revenue signal (ARR), and whether there's a known workaround. If all low, we close as "won't fix" + comms.

Ramya: For engineering: we need a deterministic score so triage isn't subjective. Suggest categories: small (config/UI copy), medium (small backend change), large (schema or infra). Also: auto-linking is doable with a rules engine + simple text matching. Dev effort ~2-3 sprints for full automation, but we can ship a manual triage UI in 1 sprint.

Maya: Cool. Drafting a priority matrix idea (lightweight):

```
priority_score = 4*customer_count + 3*revenue_signal + 2*no_workaround - engineering_effort_score
# customer_count: 0..5 (0=single, 5=10+), revenue_signal: 0..3, no_workaround: 0/1, engineering_effort_score: 0..6
# thresholds: score >= 12 -> P1 (invest), 8..11 -> P2 (scheduled), <8 -> backlog/notify
```

Can we agree on weights? This gives a repeatable signal that Support/Product can share with customers.

Devon: That looks good. Can we add a rule for duplicates window? Propose: if two or more requests with same canonical tag within 30 days -> auto-link. If 5+ unique tenants in 60 days -> bump score +2.

Eli: Also want a customer comms template we can use when closing as duplicate or low-priority — sets expectations.

Maya: Draft template below, feel free to edit: 

"Hi <Customer Name>,
Thanks for the request. We've linked this ask to an existing feature request in our backlog so you can track progress: <link>. At this time it's prioritized based on overall customer demand and engineering effort. If this poses a critical business impact we can re-evaluate sooner — please reply with details and your expected timeline.

Best,
Support Team"

Devon: I'll add that to the support playbook and a canned response in Intercom. :white_check_mark:

Ramya: For automation, here's a sample matching snippet we could start with (very conservative):

```
# pseudo
KEY_PHRASES = ["rate limit", "per-tenant limit", "tenant quota", "quota UI"]
if any(phrase in lowercase(body) for phrase in KEY_PHRASES):
    tag = "triage/possible-rate-limit"
```

We can expand with a simple fingerprint for semantic similarity later (embedding threshold).

Maya: Love it. Action items:
- Devon: add canned response + update playbook (owner) — due EOD Thu
- Ramya: estimate effort for manual triage UI (1 sprint?) and automation (2-3 sprints) — due Mon
- Eli: collect top 5 customers where this is blocking and add ARR notes — due Fri
- Maya: finalize numeric weights for the priority_score and put in the triage doc — due Mon

Eli: I'll send the customer list. One more ask — can we add a status tag convention so customers get a clear one-line: `status/stacked`, `status/scheduled`, `status/needs-info`?

Devon: Yes — support-bot can apply `status/stacked` on auto-link, and `status/needs-info` when we ask for more detail. Will prototype tagging rules this week.

support-bot: Noted. Will add `triage/auto-link` and `status/stacked` actions to the ticket workflow (staging only initially).

Ramya: +1 :thumbsup:

Maya: Great alignment. If nobody objects, I'll publish this as the team rulebook for duplicate merging and the comms template, then we can iterate after the first 2 weeks of use.

Devon: No objections from support.

Eli: 👍

Maya: Closing thread — will send follow-up doc and link.
